title: Sign-in screen
purpose: Login view; credentials are validated by the API, not hard-coded in the page.

title: Rejected sign-in
purpose: A wrong password is refused with a generic message (HTTP 401).

title: Dashboard (default environment)
purpose: KPIs, security posture, cost trend, cost by service and compliance derived from the persisted simulated environment.

title: Simulator configuration
purpose: Seed, region, resource counts, utilization, misconfiguration rates, quotas, time, pricing and scenario probabilities.

title: Misconfiguration rates and scenario probabilities
purpose: Clean preset: misconfiguration rates are zero, so no flaw exists until a scenario creates it.

title: Generate confirmation
purpose: Generation archives (does not delete) the previous environment and its history.

title: Environment generated
purpose: Active environment panel shows the seed, simulated clock, fingerprint and resulting resource counts (16 EC2 instances).

title: Environment history
purpose: The earlier environment is ARCHIVED, not erased; scans and audit history remain.

title: Resource inventory
purpose: Paginated inventory of every simulated resource with state, key attributes, environment and monthly cost.

title: Resource detail drawer
purpose: Per-resource properties, tags, metrics, relationships, network reachability explanation and the validated operations available.

title: Network topology (no exposure)
purpose: VPCs, public/private subnets, internet gateways, instances, databases and security groups. Nothing is exposed on a sensitive port.

title: IAM identity analysis
purpose: Principals, admin detection, MFA and access-key status, trust relationships and the escalation graph.

title: Findings on the clean environment
purpose: Before any scenario: no critical or high findings are detected.

title: Simulated time and scenarios
purpose: Manual clock controls and the ten scenarios; each changes state and names the rules expected to detect it.

title: Scenario applied
purpose: State changed (a world-open SSH rule was added); the 'state changed since last scan' chip appears because no finding exists until a scan runs.

title: Security group BEFORE remediation
purpose: The scenario's security group allows tcp/22 from 0.0.0.0/0 (resource state, before the fix).

title: Findings after the scenario and a scan
purpose: A new HIGH finding NET-001 appears, derived from the changed security group, public address and route.

title: Finding with evidence
purpose: Explanation, impact, step-by-step reachability proof, detection rule, severity reason and timeline.

title: Network topology with an exposed instance
purpose: The instance is outlined red with 'EXPOSED 22' because the network model finds SSH reachable from the internet.

title: Remediation preview (PROPOSED)
purpose: Plan, risk, and a what-if comparison computed on an isolated copy: score before/after, cost, availability, config diff. Nothing has changed yet.

title: Remediation executed and verified
purpose: The change was applied to the simulated state, the analysis re-ran, and the condition is no longer detected (VERIFIED).

title: Security group AFTER remediation
purpose: Same resource after remediation: the world-open SSH rule is gone (compare with the BEFORE screenshot).

title: Resolved finding kept in history
purpose: The finding is RESOLVED because a re-scan no longer detects it; the record and its history remain.

title: Resolved finding detail
purpose: Timeline, resolving scan, remediation record and verification result.

title: Remediation and verification history
purpose: Proposed -> executed -> verified, with score and run-rate before/after.

title: Scan history and comparison
purpose: Compare two scans: resolved/introduced findings and score change.

title: Detection rules catalogue
purpose: Each rule's logic and severity basis is documented and visible.

title: IAM privilege escalation after a permissive role
purpose: AdministratorAccess on a workload role creates escalation paths from ordinary users; red edges show the chain.

title: Cost analysis with a detected anomaly
purpose: Daily cost chart with the spike flagged (z-score above baseline), by-service breakdown and contributors.

title: Daily cost by service
purpose: Stacked daily cost per service from simulated billing.

title: Dashboard after scenarios and a rescan
purpose: Dashboard reflects the new findings, the cost anomaly and updated compliance posture.

title: Optimization recommendations
purpose: Each recommendation shows evidence, estimated saving (labelled ESTIMATED), risk and the action to take.

title: Recommendation evidence and assumptions
purpose: Supporting metrics, assumptions, risk and the executable plan.

title: Recommendation what-if preview
purpose: Cost and security effect simulated before applying.

title: Recommendation applied and verified
purpose: Run-rate before/after shows the verified (simulated) saving.

title: Verified recommendation
purpose: Estimated and verified savings are shown separately.

title: What-if comparison
purpose: Baseline vs hypothetical: cost, security score, availability, compliance and config diff; the baseline fingerprint is verified unchanged.

title: Audit log
purpose: Append-only record of generation, scenarios, scans, remediation, what-if and time changes with actor, outcome and details.

title: Audit event with before/after
purpose: A remediation event stores the changed fields before and after.

title: Configuration drift
purpose: Resources whose configuration differs from the saved baseline; security-relevant drift first. Drift is not a finding.

title: Generated report
purpose: Report built from persisted state: score, run-rate, estimated vs verified savings, remediation evidence, limitations.

title: OpenAPI documentation
purpose: FastAPI /docs listing the simulator, analysis, remediation, what-if, audit and report endpoints.

title: Read-only viewer role
purpose: A viewer sees a notice and cannot generate environments or change state (also enforced by the API with HTTP 403).
